couplets.en: Shyam has yet to come today.
So many days have passed.
My sorrow has been there too.

lines: Tere dukh mein tere gham mein
couplets.en: I have shared in your pain and sorrow.
My sorrow has been there too.

lines: Tere dukh mein tere gham mein
couplets.en: I have shared in your pain and sorrow.

lines: Mere pyaar ne diya hai tera saath har janam mein
couplets.en: My love has stood by you in every life.
Whatever life you come into again.
My shadow will be with you.
Wherever you go.

lines: Kabhi mujhko yaad karke jo bahenge tere aansoo
couplets.en: If tears should fall when you think of me.

lines: To wahin pe rok lenge unhein aake mere aansoo
couplets.en: My own tears will come to meet yours and hold them back.
Whichever way you look.
My shadow will be with you.
Wherever you go.

lines: Main agar bichhad bhi jaaun kabhi mera gham na karna
couplets.en: If we should ever part, please do not grieve for me.

lines: Mera pyaar yaad karke kabhi aankh nam na karna
couplets.en: Remember my love without letting it bring you to tears.

lines: Tu jo mud ke dekh lega
couplets.en: If you turn to look back.
My shadow will be with you.
Wherever you go.
My shadow will be with you.
My shadow.
O Hari, O Shyam.
So many days have passed.
